possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card summary provides only basic architecture, modality, and license information, with no reported evaluations, training data, or safety testing details, so the checkpoint lacks sufficient documentation for transparency.
